title: Mathematical Methods in Physics
content: Mathematical methods provide the indispensable language and tools required to formulate and solve the equations of physical reality. This curriculum covers linear operator algebras on Hilbert spaces, vector calculus, contour integration in complex analysis, group theory symmetries, and the differential geometry of curved manifolds.
